description: Patrolled the facility and served as a general security presence and visible deterrent to crime and rule infractions.
Reported all incidents, accidents and medical emergencies to law enforcement.
Responded quickly to medical emergencies, bomb threats and fire alarms.
Issued security badges and visitor passes to all guests.
Checked passes and credentials of persons seeking to enter the property.
Continuously monitored security cameras and fire, building and alarm systems.
Collected customer feedback and made process changes to exceed customer satisfaction goals.
Made reasonable procedure exceptions to accommodate unusual customer requests.
Provided accurate and appropriate information in response to customer inquiries.
Formulated and enforced Service Center policies, procedures and quality assurance measures.
Trained and instructed subordinates and supported units on transitioning into the unit.
Determined elevation and grid azimuths with maps and map overlays.
Managed receipt, storage and issue of ammunition processes.
Patrolled areas and allowed restricted area access for authorized personnel.
Led military police teams in support of battlefield operations.
Maintained complete accountability during redeployment of all sensitive items and communication equipment.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience in both personal computer support and network security, which is highly relevant to roles requiring IT expertise and security awareness. Their background in customer service suggests strong interpersonal skills suitable for engagement with clients and team members alike. The military police training indicates a history of decision-making under pressure and responsibility for the safety and protection of others.
